    if user.emial:

I have updated `app/service.py` to use `emial` when creating a `User` object and when accessing the email in `display_name`, aligning the code with the generated protobuf structure.

Summary of changes:
1.  In `app/service.py`, the `make_user` function was changed from `user_pb2.User(..., email=email, ...)` to `user_pb2.User(..., emial=email, ...)` to use the correct field name.
2.  In `app/service.py`, the `display_name` function was updated to check and format the `user.emial` field instead of `user.email`.

These changes resolve the `ValueError: Protocol message User has no "email" field` by correctly mapping the input parameter to the protobuf message field.
